Power budget summary for smore-002.

## Solar panels {@sec-solar-panel}

Using PowerFilm MPT4.8-150 [@Powerfilm_48_150] ([Datasheet](/_datahsheets/powerfilm_onp1237x54_apr22_xonlink.pdf)).

- Full sun 480 mW
- 1/4 sun 108 mW

The nominal operating voltage is 4.8 V. 

## Regulator {@sec-regulator}

Solar panel is regulated with a L7805A [@STL78] which is a 5 V version. This is probably not the best choice since the solar panel probably was under volting this value under limited light conditions. 

- Efficiency unknown.
- Should be tested with full range of voltage in future.
